prompt.subtitle: Adds to the global direction
prompt.placeholder: Action, framing, movement, special lighting or dialogue for this shot…
prompt.global: Global direction applied to this shot
export.title: Export and share
export.stems: Audio stems by role (Dialogue, Music, Ambience, SFX) and the shots’ sound
export.fileStems: 5 WAV stems in a ZIP with the video
export.socialHint: Cropped at the centre of the film.
export.upscaled: The takes are {size} at most: the export in {frame} enlarges them.
export.noteFcpxml: V1 sequence with the chosen takes, shot names and in points.
export.noteOtio: Video and audio tracks by role; opens in Resolve, Premiere (plugin) and Nuke Studio.
export.noteEdl: Universal edit list (V1 only), for grading or conforming.
export.subtitlesNote: Taken from the titles of the timeline.
export.soundNote: Two loudnorm passes: the mix is measured, then one gain brings it as close to the target as true peaks under −1 dBTP allow.
export.matched.one: Color match baked into a LUT for {count} shot.
export.matched.other: Color match baked into a LUT for {count} shots.
export.matchStale.one: {count} shot changed take since its color match: measure it again, the export ignores it.
export.matchStale.other: {count} shots changed take since their color match: measure them again, the export ignores them.
shot.title: Shot · {shot}
shot.subtitle: {start} → {end}
shot.takesNote.one: This shot has {count} take. Saving a change keeps it and marks it “Prompt modified”.
shot.takesNote.other: This shot has {count} takes. Saving a change keeps them and marks them “Prompt modified”.
shot.kept.one: {count} setting of this shot changed while you edited it; your version was kept
shot.kept.other: {count} settings of this shot changed while you edited it; your version was kept
shot.noInherited: No global reference in the project.
shot.notCast: Its card is not cast in this shot: it is not sent.
shot.fromCast: From a cast card, attached to another shot
shot.durationMax: At most {max} with the media of the shot.
shot.durationEngine: At most {max} with the engine of the shot.
shot.durationBeyondTake: Longer than its take ({take}): the shot goes back to be generated and the take stays in its history as a draft.
shot.draftsHint: Generated at once by the Generate buttons of the shot.
shot.keepFramingHint: The start image is sent as the end image too: the camera keeps the framing and the face stays the one of the start image. The subject stays in place.
shot.keepFramingLast: The shot has an end image of its own: it is sent instead of its start image.
shot.actionUndone: The action asks the subject to move, but the end image brings it back where it starts: the engine may add a double. Describe an action in place, or give another end image.
shot.staleWarning: The takes of the shot will be marked “Prompt modified”
shot.noProjectImage: No image in the project yet.
shot.noProjectVideo: No video in the project yet.
shot.profileUnsupported: {profile} does not run on this engine: the shot will be blocked.
shot.seedHint: With a seed, the first take of each run uses it and the next ones the seeds after it: generating again gives the same takes.
shot.noProjectSound: The project has no sound yet.
shot.trackSilent: Nothing between {start} and {end}: nothing is sent
shot.noTracks: No audio track is checked as a reference for the generation.
engine.title: Edit Engine
engine.subtitle: The options of the project, kept for each engine
engine.presetHint: Choosing another engine here shows its options without changing the project's engine.
engine.priority.one: {count} shot sets its own engine settings in its shot editor: they come before these.
engine.priority.other: {count} shots set their own engine settings in their shot editor: they come before these.
engine.draftsHint: For the shots that do not set their own number
engine.unavailable: This engine is not available to you: its options cannot be read.
engine.none: {engine} has no option the project can set.
engine.modelsFailed: The installed models could not be listed.
engine.time: {asked} steps instead of {base}: each take is counted at about {ratio}× the time.
shot.castEmpty: The bible has no card yet: add characters and places in Director AI › Bible.
shot.castMissing: The instruction does not name {labels}: write the visual tag of each character cast in the shot.
shot.dialogue.title: Dialogue
shot.dialogue.speaker: Speaker
shot.dialogue.placeholder: The exact words, sent as they are
shot.dialogue.notCast: This character is not cast in the shot: the engine does not see their description.
shot.dialogue.tooLong: Too many words for the length of the shot: about {limit} fit at a natural pace.
shot.dialogue.hint: MiniMax H3 and LTX speak the lines with lip sync, in the voice and language of the character set in the bible; the other engines leave them out.
shot.composedNone: Choose a generation engine to see the prompt.
shot.composedUnsaved: The prompt shows once the project is saved.
shot.composedError: The prompt could not be composed.
shot.composedHint: The instruction, the cast from the bible and the global direction, in the format of the shot’s engine, with your unsaved changes.
shot.reference.title: Prompt part from the references
shot.reference.hint.refs: What MiniMax H3 reads about the references in Ref2VA: the subject definitions, the retention lines and the citations in the shot.
shot.reference.hint.subjects: The subject definitions placed ahead of the MiniMax H3 prompt, from the cards cast in the shot.
shot.reference.hint.cast: The cards cast in the shot, repeated in the prompt in the format of its engine.
shot.reference.hint.sheet: What LTX-2.5 reads about its reference sheet in Ref2VA: the sheet described picture by picture, then the cards cast in the shot.
shot.reference.empty: Nothing is composed for this shot: it sends no reference and casts no card.
shot.reference.replaced: Replaced for this shot: this text is sent as it is instead of the composed one.
shot.reference.changed: The composed text changed since you replaced it, for example because a reference or a card changed. Your text is still sent.
shot.reference.ignored: This replacement was written for another engine: the composed text is sent.
shot.reference.waiting: The composed part shows with the prompt sent to the engine.
shot.reference.replacedWaiting: Replaced for this shot: the text shows with the prompt sent to the engine.
shot.vref.title: Reference video tracks
shot.vref.ignored.one: {engine} does not take a reference video: {labels} is not sent to this shot. Nothing is blocked.
shot.vref.ignored.other: {engine} does not take a reference video: {labels} are not sent to this shot. Nothing is blocked.
engine.sizeHint: The size of the takes of this engine in this project, for {format}. Auto follows your administrator for drafts and takes the largest size for finals. It applies to every shot on this engine.
engine.sizeCloud: A cloud model gets the ratio it offers closest to the film: there is no size to choose.
shot.vref.citeTip: Add {tag} to the instruction, at the cursor. In Ref2VA the mention goes as the video of the track; with another engine it is left out.
export.cadence.label: Frame rate
export.cadence.slow.one: {count} shot at {rates} fps will stutter in this {fps} fps film.
export.cadence.slow.other: {count} shots at {rates} fps will stutter in this {fps} fps film.
export.cadence.conforming.one: {count} version at {fps} fps on its way: the export uses it once it is ready.
export.cadence.conforming.other: {count} versions at {fps} fps on their way: the export uses them once they are ready.
export.cadence.slowed.one: {count} slowed shot waits for its version: the export repeats its frames.
export.cadence.slowed.other: {count} slowed shots wait for their version: the export repeats their frames.
